text.description_html:
Fusion B-EL-E3, Beveled Scalloped Rose Doorbell Button

Fusion Hardware's Beveled Scalloped Rose Doorbell Button takes a new approach on the lowly doorbell. It is simple enough in design to be able to blend seamlessly with any decor, but the scalloped design gives it an interesting shape that will add a beautiful point of interest to any door. It comes as a kit with a lighted button and mounting screws.

Please Note This is a replacement trim only. It comes packaged with lighted button, rosette, and installation screws. It DOES NOT include the chime.

Specifications of the Simple Doorbell Fusion E3:

  • Length: 3-1/2"
  • Width: 2-3/4"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Includes lighted button.
  • Packaged as a kit with matching finish installation screws and a lighted button.



** This item is discontinued. See available Door Bell Buttons
